policy.human_operational_identifiers: Persian digits at the display boundary; canonical value remains unchanged. Examples: order number, table number/name digits, invoice/receipt/session number.
policy.counts_quantities_durations: Use locale integer/number/percent formatters with Persian digits.
policy.human_prose_with_digits: Use humanDigits/digits for trusted human-facing labels and persisted notification prose.
policy.storage_api: Never localize canonical numeric storage or transport values.
